description: Election Commission - Mr. Sarukkalige Dhanushka Kushan Silva of the Sri Jayawardanapura Kotte Muncipal Council has Vacated his Office of Member of the Muncipal Council
categorisation: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Sri Jayawardanapura Kotte Municipal Council has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political alliance. This is an electoral matter directly related to the composition of a local government body, falling under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters, specifically concerning candidate status and office vacancies.
